settings.label: Overview
settings.text: A multi-use stick for base, spot cover and contour. It glides on, melts in and finishes with a soft, natural glow that keeps skin comfortable all day.

settings.label: Key benefits
settings.text: Mostly organic, with oils and butters that hydrate, plant extracts that calm and zero fragrance. Dermatologist tested and suitable for sensitive skin.

settings.label: How to apply
settings.text: Swipe a few strokes on the center of the face, then press out with fingertips or a dome brush. Use a lighter shade to brighten and a deeper one to shape.

settings.label: Shade guide
settings.text: Each name carries a depth number from 01 to 10 and a letter for undertone: C for cool, N for neutral, W for warm. Match on the jaw in daylight.

settings.label: Certifications
settings.text: Certified organic, cruelty-free and made in small batches in the USA.

settings.heading: Four plant actives, each with a job

settings.title: Jojoba oil
settings.text: Mimics skin's own oils so the stick glides without feeling greasy.

settings.title: Shea butter
settings.text: Cushions and softens, which keeps dry patches from catching.

settings.title: Calendula extract
settings.text: Soothes redness and helps skin look calmer through the day.

settings.title: Rosehip oil
settings.text: Brings a gentle glow and supports a smoother-looking surface.

settings.title: Base
settings.text: Stroke across forehead, cheeks and chin, then press out for an even layer.

settings.title: Correct
settings.text: Dab a deeper or lighter shade over dark circles and blemishes and tap to blend.

settings.title: Set
settings.text: Skip powder where you want glow, or dust a little on the center of the face.

settings.heading: Makeup with measurable skin benefits.
settings.text: Results come from a consumer panel after four weeks of daily wear, with lab tests on skin cells supporting the ingredient claims.

settings.label: How much coverage will I get?
settings.text: Light to medium and buildable. A single pass evens tone, a second pass hides blemishes.

settings.label: How do I choose between neighbouring shades?
settings.text: Choose by undertone first. If you are between depths, take the lighter one and shape with a deeper stick.

settings.label: Does it suit dry or mature skin?
settings.text: Yes. The butter base cushions dryness and avoids settling into lines.

settings.label: Can I wear it over serum or oil?
settings.text: Let your skincare absorb for a minute first, so the stick glides instead of sliding.
